title: gdpr.erasure.requested
description: stapel-gdpr 0.5.0+ asks every data owner that claims subject_type to erase its slice. This module claims account only — every row here hangs off a wallet or a subscription keyed by the user id, and no billing.* payload carries a workspace or entity id — and ignores every other subject_type (gdpr creates no part for an owner that does not claim it). Documentation of what is consumed: the authoritative schema is the emitter's, in stapel-gdpr/schemas/emits/.
